newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures down in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures down in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower in after-hours trade on Wednesday, as the yen"s rise against the dollar prompted local investors to sell rubber futures, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 2.6 yen per kg lower than the day"s close. July, the most-active contract, was off 2.4 yen at 155.9 yen. Daily volume was 9,378 lots.

During the day, the market started the day weaker, following price rallies on Tuesday. "It was natural for the market to fall as there were no special factors behind the sharp price rallies on Tuesday," one trader said.
